checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same sneaker, original side view, fully inside frame
must.why: Same side view, size and position; fully in frame. Collar/heel slightly redrawn.
Laces, stitching, heel tab and sole dots are preserved, with minor regeneration.

must.item: Grey floor and clutter replaced by seamless white
must.why: Background is white with no clutter and no visible floor boundary.

must.item: Soft shadow without visible floor boundary
must.why: There is a soft shadow under the sole, darker at the toe and heel; it has no hard edge.
The image is about 640x384, which is roughly 5:3 (1.67), close to the original ratio. It is not exactly 16:9, but it matches the original. No text.

faults.what: Shadow is somewhat dark and heavy at the toe and heel tip, and the shoe's inner collar was slightly redrawn (the original shows a lining and a different opening)
Aspect ratio is about 5:3, not exactly 16:9, matching the original

summary: The sneaker is faithfully placed on clean white with a soft shadow and no text; only the collar interior and the slightly heavy shadow differ slightly from the original.
